title: Trump NATO Envoy Says EU Should Take ‘Aggressive’ Line on Russia
summary: President Donald Trump’s envoy to NATO said European allies should take a “more aggressive” approach to Moscow and move forward with plans to tap immobilized Russian assets to fund Ukraine’s war effort.

title: Quicksilver Author Callie Hart Talks the Rise of Romantasy
summary: TikTok pulled the self-published romance writer out of obscurity and into a Netflix deal. Now she’s releasing Brimstone, the sequel to her 2024 smash hit.
